title: Node event
description: A new version of node `n`. The server resolves `n`, assigns `ver` and takes the board from the path; a sent item may name `base`, the version it was based on. Its `kind` decides whether it asks the person for an answer.

node.description: The content of this version of the node.

node.title: Flat fee or per seat?
node.body: Which model fits a team of ten?

base.description: The `ver` you read; if the card has moved on, the item fails with `conflict`.

by.description: Who wrote the line; always `agent` for this event.

board.description: The board the line belongs to; the server takes it from the path.

ver.description: The node version this line wrote.

noItem.description: From ledger v11 a node names no `item`: its kind decides whether it asks for an answer.
noItem.$comment: Kept apart from `body` so a stored line from v10 or older, which may carry `item`, still reads. Was: api.md 118

item.description: `item` is gone: the kind decides. A `question`, `decision` or `action` card asks the person; any other kind takes a note or Later.

rules.description: A stored line from v11 on names no `item`; an app card names its app and no other card names one (on every line: no line before v17 names either).
rules.$comment: Kept apart from `core` so a failed rule never hides which fields are known (see common.schema.json `stampAgent`). Was: api.md 118, 150

appRule.description: Kind `app` needs `app` and takes no `size`; no other kind names an app.
appRule.$comment: Kept apart from `body` so a failed rule never hides which fields are known. Was: api.md 150, D-047 ruling 3

size.description: An app card is as big as its panel; set app.w and app.h instead.

app.description: Only an app card names an app; draw kind `app`.

region.description: The container (region) the node sits in.

kind.description: `question`, `decision` and `action` ask the person for ✓ or ✗; `finding`, `risk`, `topic` and `note` don't; `app` shows an app you built in a panel (name it in `app`). The person can note or save any node.

item.description: On lines from ledger v10 and older only, and ignored: the node's kind decides whether it asks for an answer.

lane.description: The lane the node sits in, for a container in `lanes` mode.

emphasis.description: True draws the card emphasised; never over the person's size.

size.description: Your suggested size; the person's wins. Not on an app card.

app.description: App cards only, and required there: which app, and the panel's size in px.
